db:select.doc:name: Count by region
db:select.db:sql: SELECT REGION, STATE_NAME, SEARCH_TERM, COUNT(*) AS ESTABLISHMENTS FROM MD26_DB.MARKET.ESTABLISHMENTS GROUP BY REGION, STATE_NAME, SEARCH_TERM ORDER BY REGION, SEARCH_TERM

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "OK", source: "INEGI DENUE", target: "MD26_DB.MARKET.ESTABLISHMENTS", stagedRows: sum(vars.batches.rows default [0]), totalEstablishments: sum(payload.ESTABLISHMENTS default [0]), batches: vars.batches, byRegion: payload }

http:request.doc:name: GET DENUE BuscarEntidad

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java import trim from dw::core::Strings fun clean(s) = if (isEmpty(s)) null else trim(s as String) fun num(s) = if (isEmpty(s)) null else (s as Number) --- ((payload default []) distinctBy $.Id) map (e) -> do { var place = (e.Ubicacion default "") splitBy "," --- { DENUE_ID: e.Id as String, CLEE: clean(e.CLEE), NAME: clean(e.Nombre), // CLEE = 2-digit state + 3-digit municipality + 6-digit SCIAN activity code + ... ACTIVITY_CODE: if (sizeOf(e.CLEE default "") >= 11) (e.CLEE as String)[5 to 10] else null, ACTIVITY_CLASS: clean(e.Clase_actividad), SEARCH_TERM: vars.term, STRATUM: clean(e.Estrato), BUSINESS_TYPE: clean(e.Tipo), STREET: clean((e.Tipo_vialidad default "") ++ " " ++ (e.Calle default "")), EXT_NUMBER: clean(e.Num_Exterior), NEIGHBORHOOD: clean(e.Colonia), POSTAL_CODE: clean(e.CP), LOCALITY: clean(place[0]), MUNICIPALITY: clean(place[1]), STATE_CODE: vars.state.code, STATE_NAME: vars.state.name, REGION: vars.state.region, LATITUDE: num(e.Latitud), LONGITUDE: num(e.Longitud) } }

set-variable.doc:name: Track batch
set-variable.value: #[vars.batches + { state: vars.state.name, term: vars.term, rows: sizeOf(payload) }]

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Insert into staging
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO MD26_DB.MARKET.ESTABLISHMENTS_STAGE (DENUE_ID, CLEE, NAME, ACTIVITY_CODE, ACTIVITY_CLASS, SEARCH_TERM, STRATUM, BUSINESS_TYPE, STREET, EXT_NUMBER, NEIGHBORHOOD, POSTAL_CODE, LOCALITY, MUNICIPALITY, STATE_CODE, STATE_NAME, REGION, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) VALUES (:DENUE_ID, :CLEE, :NAME, :ACTIVITY_CODE, :ACTIVITY_CLASS, :SEARCH_TERM, :STRATUM, :BUSINESS_TYPE, :STREET, :EXT_NUMBER, :NEIGHBORHOOD, :POSTAL_CODE, :LOCALITY, :MUNICIPALITY, :STATE_CODE, :STATE_NAME, :REGION, :LATITUDE, :LONGITUDE)

db:update.doc:name: MERGE staging → ESTABLISHMENTS
db:update.db:sql: MERGE INTO MD26_DB.MARKET.ESTABLISHMENTS t USING ( SELECT * FROM MD26_DB.MARKET.ESTABLISHMENTS_STAGE QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DENUE_ID ORDER BY SEARCH_TERM) = 1 ) s ON t.DENUE_ID = s.DENUE_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CLEE = s.CLEE, NAME = s.NAME, ACTIVITY_CODE = s.ACTIVITY_CODE, ACTIVITY_CLASS = s.ACTIVITY_CLASS, SEARCH_TERM = s.SEARCH_TERM, STRATUM = s.STRATUM, BUSINESS_TYPE = s.BUSINESS_TYPE, STREET = s.STREET, EXT_NUMBER = s.EXT_NUMBER, NEIGHBORHOOD = s.NEIGHBORHOOD, POSTAL_CODE = s.POSTAL_CODE, LOCALITY = s.LOCALITY, MUNICIPALITY = s.MUNICIPALITY, STATE_CODE = s.STATE_CODE, STATE_NAME = s.STATE_NAME, REGION = s.REGION, LATITUDE = s.LATITUDE, LONGITUDE = s.LONGITUDE, LOADED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), LAST_MODIFIED = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DENUE_ID, CLEE, NAME, ACTIVITY_CODE, ACTIVITY_CLASS, SEARCH_TERM, STRATUM, BUSINESS_TYPE, STREET, EXT_NUMBER, NEIGHBORHOOD, POSTAL_CODE, LOCALITY, MUNICIPALITY, STATE_CODE, STATE_NAME, REGION, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, LOADED_AT, LAST_MODIFIED) VALUES (s.DENUE_ID, s.CLEE, s.NAME, s.ACTIVITY_CODE, s.ACTIVITY_CLASS, s.SEARCH_TERM, s.STRATUM, s.BUSINESS_TYPE, s.STREET, s.EXT_NUMBER, s.NEIGHBORHOOD, s.POSTAL_CODE, s.LOCALITY, s.MUNICIPALITY, s.STATE_CODE, s.STATE_NAME, s.REGION, s.LATITUDE, s.LONGITUDE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
